entries.heading: REMOVAL OF ADJUNCT PROFESSOR LIMIT AT UNITED STATES MERCHANT MARINE ACADEMY
ancestors: DIVISION C—DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY NATIONAL SECURITY AUTHORIZATIONS AND OTHER AUTHORIZATIONS
entries.text:
SEC. 3509. REMOVAL OF ADJUNCT PROFESSOR LIMIT AT UNITED STATES 
                          MERCHANT MARINE ACADEMY.

    Section 51317 of title 46, United States Code, is amended--
            (1) in subsection (b)--
                    (A) in paragraph (1), by striking ``and'' at the 
                end; and
                    (B) in paragraph (2), by striking the period at the 
                end and inserting ``; and''; and
            (2) by striking subsections (c) and (d).
